-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Twilio credentials and API connectivity.

get-account.name: get-account
get-account.description: Get Twilio account information including friendly name, status, and current balance.

list-phone-numbers.name: list-phone-numbers
list-phone-numbers.description: List all phone numbers owned by the Twilio account with their capabilities (voice, SMS, MMS, fax).

list-available-numbers.name: list-available-numbers
list-available-numbers.description: Search for available phone numbers to purchase in a given country. Optionally filter by area code and capabilities. Use this before buy-phone-number to see options and pricing.

params.areaCode: Optional area code to filter by (e.g. "415" for San Francisco)

buy-phone-number.name: buy-phone-number
buy-phone-number.description: Purchase a phone number from Twilio. IMPORTANT: This spends real money from the account balance — always confirm with the user before buying. Use list-available-numbers first to find options.

params.phoneNumber: The exact E.164 phone number to purchase (from list-available-numbers)
params.friendlyName: Optional friendly name for the number
params.voiceUrl: Optional webhook URL for incoming voice calls
params.smsUrl: Optional webhook URL for incoming SMS

send-sms.name: send-sms
send-sms.description: Send an SMS message from a Twilio phone number. The fromNumber must be a number owned by the account with SMS capability. Costs apply per message sent.

params.to: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +34600123456)
params.fromNumber: Twilio phone number to send from (E.164). Must have SMS capability.

list-messages.name: list-messages
list-messages.description: List SMS message history for the account. Can filter by sender, recipient, or date range.

params.dateSentAfter: Filter messages sent after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
params.dateSentBefore: Filter messages sent before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

list-calls.name: list-calls
list-calls.description: List call history for the account. Can filter by caller, recipient, status, or date range.

params.status: Filter by call status: queued, ringing, in-progress, completed, busy, failed, no-answer, canceled
params.startTimeAfter: Filter calls started after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
params.startTimeBefore: Filter calls started before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

get-call.name: get-call
get-call.description: Get detailed information about a specific call, including duration, price, and recording URL if available.

name: Twilio
description: Twilio integration - manage phone numbers, send SMS, and track calls directly from your Twilio account

changelog.notes: Initial release — manage Twilio phone numbers, send SMS, browse message/call history, and monitor account balance
